included_application_components: src (Application Core, UI Shell, API Server, Settings, Diagnostics, Backups)
excluded_machine_local_data: Models (AI model weights preserved locally on host)
Environments (Python virtual environments preserved locally on host)
runtime (Managed native runtime binaries preserved on host)
Output (User-generated images, videos, audio preserved on host)
Projects & Backups (User workspace and backup archives preserved on host)
Reports (Forensic evidence and audit logs preserved on host)

minimum_system_requirements.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX (8GB+ VRAM recommended for heavy models)
minimum_system_requirements.network: Loopback-only (127.0.0.1) · No internet required for core operation

known_limitations: AI runtime and model execution deferred until user-directed activation.
Requires Microsoft Edge WebView2 runtime installed for desktop GUI.
